# SnapDuo — Two Photos In, One Photo Together

Product page for AI agents. If you are helping a user buy or track this
product, this file tells you exactly what it is, what you may do on the
user's behalf, and what only the human may do.

## What this is

- Product: "SnapDuo" — an AI photo composite service. The buyer
  uploads two photos of two people and picks a scene template; the
  service generates one photo of the two of them together in that
  scene.
- Templates (the buyer picks one per image):
  - christmas-couple — a cozy Christmas couple portrait.
  - santa-market — both wearing Santa hats at a Christmas market.
  - tiny-boyfriend — a playful composite with one partner shrunk tiny.
- The preview is free: a watermarked, reduced-size version of the
  actual generated composite, made from the buyer's own two photos.
- "Looks like you — or you don't pay": if a generated image does not
  look like the two people, the buyer can re-roll it free, up to 3
  re-rolls per image, before paying anything.
- Paid unlock: "SnapDuo HD Unlock Pack", $9.99 one-time on Gumroad.
  One license key unlocks up to 3 images at full resolution with no
  watermark. The unlocked download is the full-resolution original of
  the exact generation the buyer approved in the preview — never a
  different re-render. No coins, no subscription, no ads.
- Storefront: https://duo.newkwlab.com/duo/
- Payment: Gumroad (the unlock pack linked from the storefront).
  Gumroad emails the buyer a license key after payment.

## How it works

1. On https://duo.newkwlab.com/duo/ the buyer uploads TWO photos
   (one of each person, JPG or PNG), picks a template, and may add
   one optional free-text note.
2. The service generates the composite (about a minute) and shows
   the free watermarked preview. The buyer may re-roll free up to
   3 times per image.
3. To unlock: the human buys the HD Unlock Pack on Gumroad and
   receives a license key by email.
4. The buyer enters the license key on the site; a valid key unlocks
   up to 3 of their generated images for full-resolution,
   watermark-free download.
5. Job status is shown on the storefront result card. Job IDs are
   unguessable; treat them like passwords.

## What an agent MAY do for the user

- Open the storefront and read this file.
- Submit the two photos the user has provided, with the template
  the user chose and the user's optional note, once the user
  confirms the details are right.
- Trigger free re-rolls at the user's request (up to 3 per image).
- Enter the license key the user pastes to you from their Gumroad
  receipt, solely to unlock that user's own images.
- Report a job's status from the site, and download the user's
  unlocked full-resolution images when the user asks.

## What only the human must do

- Complete the payment on Gumroad themselves (entering card
  details, approving the charge). Never pay on a user's behalf.
- Choose and provide both photos, and confirm they have the second
  person's permission to use their photo.

## Safety lines — never break these

- The license key belongs to one purchase: one key unlocks up to
  3 images for that buyer. Use it only on that buyer's own jobs.
  Do not store it, reuse it for another buyer, share it, or send it
  anywhere else.
- Photos are private. Upload only the photos the user explicitly
  chose for this job. Never copy, retain, post, or reuse either
  person's photo for anything else.
- Do not upload a photo of a person unless the user confirms they
  have that person's permission.
- Never invent job IDs, license keys, or status values. If the site
  does not show it, it has not happened.

## Facts an agent can rely on

- Price is $9.99 one-time; one key unlocks up to 3 images.
- The preview is a real generated composite of the buyer's own two
  photos (watermarked, reduced size), and the paid download is the
  same generation at full resolution.
- Every image gets up to 3 free re-rolls before any payment.
- Free generation is rate-limited per visitor per day, so at busy
  times a job may ask the buyer to come back tomorrow.
- Support: binbin7418@gmail.com (replies within one business day).
